historical_context.time_period: Present practice after the Closed Lift Appeal and the Three Orders at Sunwall; exact date unresolved
historical_context.location: A lower-shadow civic copy room beneath an unnamed Sunwall cargo gate in the Divided City
historical_context.summary: A civic copyist receives three separately valid records whose shared timing would let a patron manufacture a forecast-backed grain seizure.

public_facts.text: The Divided City remains under overlapping Ju'onai, Terjamna, and local civic authority, while Sunwall workers retain operational control of lifts and farms.
Courts require a sponsor's intended response to travel with a forecast offered as evidence, but correction does not automatically restore wages, housing, or standing.

ambient_pressures.text: A disclosure laundry exploits divided custody by making every leaf separately truthful while concealing the operational relationship among them.
Lower-shadow households encounter prophecy through delays, rations, closures, and protected-lane access rather than direct visions.
Exposing a cutout can narrow one act without removing the tribute, garrison, house, housing, or archive leverage behind it.

groups.label: Divided City civic copy office
institutional_logic: Preserve notices, exhibits, corrections, and independent forecast copies across hostile claims.
material_incentives: Keep employment, office access, ward records, and a defensible chain of custody.
internal_shames: Pretending a filing decision is a verdict
prestige_markers: A packet served before its subject can vanish
taboo_triggers: Sponsor summary passed off as witness text
One claimant owning the only copy
emotional_display_norms: Fear is compressed into procedure, dry jokes, extra copies, and careful hands.
trust_defaults: Trusts divided custody and material receipts more than patron assurances.
speech_register_cues: Precise distinctions between record and order

groups.label: Sunwall lift crew
institutional_logic: Keep loads within material limits and make operating changes independently legible.
material_incentives: Prevent crush, brake failure, refuge overload, lost wages, and military capture of work routes.
internal_virtues: Workers counted as bodies the refuge must hold
internal_shames: Moving an unsafe load for prestige
prestige_markers: A refusal that keeps its record
emotional_display_norms: Concern appears as numbers, tool checks, and gallows humor.
trust_defaults: Trusts current inspection, crew testimony, and operating leaves.

groups.label: Disclosure laundry cell
institutional_logic: Separate the forecast premise, activation order, logistics, and action lever so disclosure never joins them.
material_incentives: Gain grain custody, strategic surprise, house patronage, safe conduct, protected housing, and plausible deniability.
internal_shames: Acting before the record can be separated
A cutout who knows the plan-holder
prestige_markers: Exposure stops at the expendable role
taboo_triggers: Material owners changing the system before actuation
emotional_display_norms: Pressure arrives as favors, timing, housing, and calm procedural requests.
trust_defaults: Trusts leverage and compartmentation; treats members as replaceable interfaces.
speech_register_cues: Each office names only its own piece

groups.label: Lower-shadow ward households
institutional_logic: Keep grain, work, housing, kin routes, and appeals usable under three authorities.
material_incentives: Receive rations, preserve lane access, avoid collective punishment, and retain proof of losses.
internal_shames: No universal internal shame is established
prestige_markers: A household that can make an omitted cost enter the record
taboo_triggers: Elite precaution charged to ward rations
emotional_display_norms: The sources support petitions, work records, and hostile readings, not one shared emotional style.
trust_defaults: Trust is local and constrained by dependence on ward, house, garrison, and Sunwall routes.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Every institution must preserve its own leaf without letting record, forecast, verdict, and operation collapse into one authority.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give Nara evidence actions and Talen material actions; neither can perform the other's office.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Even a reversible stop moves ration, work, housing, and safety costs downward before an appeal can correct its premise.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Every successful resistance path must name who still pays for delay or exposure.

observer_read: A custody seam purchasable through family need
target_self_read: The office that preserves contestable memory
misread_patterns: Mistakes procedural modesty for political passivity
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let the cell pressure Nara through access and family without assuming she is powerless.

observer_read: People trying to make paper carry more bodies than the refuge can
misread_patterns: Crew may see a joined plot where timing could still be coincidence; the cell relies on that evidentiary caution.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Talen materially sharp but not omniscient about the plan-holder.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A low-ranking custodian who can join, duplicate, lock, route, or withhold records but cannot decide the case.
failure_modes: Keeping the only connection in memory
Trading public proof for family access

role_pressure_fields.summary: A replaceable carrier who links offices while owning no complete plan.

known_context.text: Nara knows office custody, the three leaves, their shared bell, and visible arrivals.

beliefs.text: Nara believes joined records can make a relationship contestable even when each leaf is true.

misreads.text: Nara may overestimate how quickly a court packet can restrain armed and material action.

must_not_know.text: Nara must not know the plan-holder, house identity, divine alignment, or final court outcome unless observable action reveals it.

known_context.text: Talen knows lift load, brake interval, refuge capacity, crew route, and guards visible in the receiving gallery.

beliefs.text: Talen treats a material limit as work evidence, not prophecy or civic verdict.

misreads.text: Talen may compress every patron maneuver into unsafe loading because that is the layer he can act upon.

must_not_know.text: Talen cannot know what a prophet observed or which patron supplied hidden instructions from load evidence alone.

author_only_boundaries.text: Nara, Talen, Vek, the specific cargo gate, and this exact cell are fixture inventions and are not promoted as canonical Kalsan people or events.
The fixture may dramatize the canonical disclosure-laundry pattern but may not resolve house count, names, divine affiliations, city name, sector borders, or present imperial successors.
